notes: Layer ids were read from service metadata on 2026-09-23. The adapter resolves layers by name at request time and does not treat these ids as permanent.
Texas status authority is the Railroad Commission. A GIS symbol is not a G-10 or W-10 schedule and is not plug evidence.
Orphan status is taken only from the RRC Orphan Wells layer or a state orphan list, never from a symbol description.
HIFLD Open and the former NASA NCCS map host are not used.
Queries always pass an envelope, an explicit field list, and a bounded where clause. There is no national extract.

env.RRC_FEATURE_URL: MapServer root for Texas RRC wells. Default is the public viewer service below.
env.NM_OCD_URL: MapServer root for New Mexico OCD wells.
env.CO_ECMC_URL: Feature layer for Colorado ECMC / OGCC wells. Discovered, not queried for dots.
env.OCC_URL: Oklahoma OCC well FeatureServer. Discovered, not queried for dots.
env.WELL_CACHE_DIR: Optional directory for geohash-5 response cache files.
env.WELL_STALE_HOURS: Cache lifetime. Clamped to 6 through 24 hours. Default 12.
env.PUBLIC_WELL_API_ORIGIN: Origin operators publish for the map. The map reads ?wellApi= or window.SITELINE_WELL_API.

cameron.note: Missing bbox returns this AOI only. A Cameron-wide count on 2026-09-23 was 2325 wells.

permian.note: Requires bbox and zoom. A 0.1 degree Midland sample counted 990 Texas wells.

ashburn.note: Texas RRC count for this envelope on 2026-09-23 was 0. NETL is not a backfill.

limits: Operator and lease name are not on Well Locations. Those fields stay blank.
SYMNUM 7, 8, and 10 do not set pa_confirmed.
No plug date is on this service.

sources.status_authority: status and status_cod on the feature. Layer names are not status.
sources.plug_date: plug_date is evidence only when it falls in 1901 through 2100. Esri sentinel values (year 1900 and year 9999) are not plug dates.

rejected.result: 404 Service not found on 2026-09-23. Public catalog lists RRC_Public_Viewer_Srvs and tpms only.
New Mexico copy of Texas well classes. Not used as Texas status authority.
HIFLD Open was discontinued around 2025-08. The NASA NCCS map host is not a source.
NETL operating and orphan overlays stay off this API. They are not a state system of record and are not an Ashburn backfill.
